jyutping: jau6 daai6 fung1 jau6 daai6 jyu5

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for stormy weather, especially when both the wind and rain are strong.

examples.english: It’s stormy today, so don’t go out.
examples.traditional: 今日又大風又大雨，唔好出街喇。
